items.title: The Los Angeles Sparks have racked up 95 total assists across their last 3 games, the most ever in WNBA history by a team over any three-game stretch. It breaks the record (92) held by this year’s Chicago Sky.

items.title: Final: Sky 95, Sparks 88. Los Angeles took a small fourth-quarter lead, but a 22-7 Chicago run put this out of reach. Sparks played well in the second and third quarters, but the first and fourth killed them. They fall to 11-18. Dearica Hamby had 22 points, 14 rebounds.

items.title: Being a referee is a thankless job. Games are so fast and physical that it’s almost impossible to get things completely right all the time. But WNBA referees have a uncanny penchant for making every wrong call you can ever make and being steadfast in their wrongness.
items.author: Justin Russo
items.body_excerpt: Being a referee is a thankless job. Games are so fast and physical that it’s almost impossible to get things completely right all the time. But WNBA referees have a uncanny penchant for making every wrong call you can ever make and being steadfast in their wrongness.
